blocks.text: Your free account is ready. Here is how to use it:

items: Every day, one match is free. With your free account, you see its pick, its calculated chance and why.
Compare that chance with the odds at your licensed bookmaker, then you decide.
The Methodology page explains how these chances are calculated.

blocks.text: The free match right now:
You did not ask to receive our emails, so we will only send you emails about your account. You can change your mind at any time in My account, under Notifications.

blocks.text: Your free account gives you the pick for one free match every day. Pro opens all the others:

The most likely scorelines, in the best-measured leagues
The day's Small and Big combo, the Gold Selection and the scorer of the day
